_about: Free for All spawns by the spawn rule, twice as many (the owner, 2026-11-14: "there should be a rule that spawns are inside buildings or close to two walls or some cover", "and none at the perimeter", "let's make other maps have x2 spawns too"): on every map but Rudnya, each team-2 spawn that fails the rule (cover, past the perimeter band) or the spawn checks (standing floor, body clear, harmful zones 2 m away) moves to a place that passes them, one that passes but faces a wall is turned, and new points that pass them, copies of a solo spawn (20 m exclusion, 500 ms protection), double the count; the places chosen so the inner area has places to spawn everywhere. Training Camp's 26 stay as they are and its 26 new ones stand on the ground inside its fence. No distance between spawns is kept ("spawns can be as close as possible"). Generated by scripts/ffa-mode/make_cover_edits.py from cover-maps.tsv (check-points to_cover). The free for all's own projects only; the last Free for All list (its new points copy the 500 ms ffa-protection-ms-1 gave the others).
